question: How many customers are in the database?
What is the total revenue in USD from completed orders?
sql: SELECT SUM(o.quantity*p.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.status='completed'

question: Which product category generates the most revenue from completed orders?
sql: SELECT p.category FROM orders o JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.quantity*p.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders were cancelled?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='cancelled'

question: Which customer has spent the most on completed orders?
sql: SELECT c.name FROM orders o JOIN products p USING(product_id) JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE o.status='completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(o.quantity*p.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which country has the most customers?
sql: SELECT country FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, country LIMIT 1

question: What is the average order value in USD across completed orders?
sql: SELECT AVG(o.quantity*p.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.status='completed'

question: What was the completed-order revenue in March 2025, in USD?
sql: SELECT SUM(o.quantity*p.unit_price) FROM orders o JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.status='completed' AND o.order_date LIKE '2025-03%'

question: How many distinct products are in the Electronics category?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category='Electronics'
